events.subtitle: The Last Hurrah Tour 2026 — with VIAL

priority_review.rationale: Scarcity challenge: L7's influence and longevity are not sufficient for S. The event-specific fact is that The Last Hurrah is the band's announced farewell world-tour chapter, and the official Washington presenter bills this exact date under that tour name. Would A+ still capture the recommendation? No: the Howard Theatre date is a local opportunity inside an explicitly final touring chapter, so missing it would carry genuine regret rather than merely mean passing on a strong active-tour show. S is warranted. S+ is not: the farewell run contains many dates, including Philadelphia the following night and New York two nights later, and Washington is not presented as the final-ever performance.

events.factual_description: Union Stage Presents lists L7: The Last Hurrah Tour 2026 at the Howard Theatre in Washington, DC on Wednesday, October 21, 2026, with VIAL. The event is all ages, with doors at 7:00 PM and showtime at 8:00 PM, at 620 T Street NW. The official presenter routes purchases to an exact Opendate order page. L7's official site currently markets tour-specific VIP packages that include a limited-edition farewell L7 tour poster. Pitchfork's May 7, 2026 tour announcement reports that L7 describes The Last Hurrah as the first leg of its farewell world tour and lists Washington on October 21, Philadelphia on October 22, New York on October 24 and the Los Angeles tour finale on November 14. No member-level touring personnel or face-value ticket price is recorded because those details were not verified from the accessible exact event/ticket sources in this pass.

en.why_it_matters: The point is not simply that L7 remains a foundational bridge between Los Angeles punk, heavy alternative rock and the grunge era. The Washington date belongs to The Last Hurrah, the band's announced farewell touring chapter. That turns the Howard Theatre show into a closing encounter with a band whose abrasive guitars, pop instincts and physical live attack helped define a whole strain of American rock.
en.trip_verdict: Keep October 21 clear and take the Howard Theatre date rather than chasing the corridor. If Washington becomes impossible, Philadelphia the next night or New York on October 24 are the nearest fallbacks inside the same farewell run.

es.why_it_matters: El punto no es simplemente que L7 siga siendo un puente fundamental entre el punk de Los Ángeles, el rock alternativo pesado y la era del grunge. La fecha de Washington forma parte de The Last Hurrah, el capítulo de despedida anunciado por la banda. Eso convierte la noche del Howard Theatre en un encuentro de cierre con un grupo cuya mezcla de guitarras abrasivas, instinto pop y ataque físico en vivo ayudó a definir toda una veta del rock estadounidense.
es.trip_verdict: Dejaría libre el 21 de octubre y aprovecharía el Howard Theatre en vez de perseguir la gira por el corredor. Si Washington se vuelve imposible, Filadelfia al día siguiente o Nueva York el 24 son las alternativas cercanas dentro de la misma despedida.
